note: Sequential M4 calibration controls for one vLLM worker, one model and one cache namespace. Retargeted to Qwen3-0.6B on the vLLM CPU backend on 2026-11-07; its tokenizer files equal the earlier Qwen3-8B pin. build_probes.py turns this into exact request bodies and local expected token IDs. No step here has run against an engine.

text.rule_line: Rule {index:02d}: describe each change, keep unrelated files untouched, and report test results exactly as observed.
text.base_question: List the three files you would read first to fix a failing unit test, and why.
text.late_question: List the three files you would read first to fix a failing unit test, and when.
text.assistant_reply: README.md, the failing test file, and the module it imports.
text.followup: Now name the first command you would run.

sequence.accept: served model name recorded in the run manifest
HTTP 200 and success true; otherwise stop
returned prompt_token_ids equal local IDs element by element
ID parity; cached_tokens reported and 0. Missing details block every hit claim
ID parity; cached_tokens positive and at most prompt_tokens - 1. Record the exact value; do not predict it from block size
cached_tokens at most the local LCP with base; record the gap to LCP and the block geometry that explains it
cached_tokens positive and at most the local LCP with base
ID parity; record returned generated token IDs

ID parity; cached_tokens at most the local LCP with base. The empty thinking cue in base is replaced by the fixed assistant reply, so a hit beyond that boundary would contradict the local model. The fixed reply is not the generated output, so this probe does not reproduce real agent cache state
returned prompt_token_ids equal direct-cold; cached_tokens 0; proxy capture integrity verified. Timing comparison needs repeated pairs and is not decided by one request

stop_rules: Stop at the first ID parity mismatch and keep the mismatching request and response bodies.
Stop if a reset returns success false or a non-200 status.
Stop if prompt_tokens_details or per-request metrics are absent; record them as unavailable, never as zero.
No retries. A transport failure ends the run with the failed step recorded.
Other check failures are recorded and the sequence continues, so one run shows every control's outcome.

check_definitions.parity: returned prompt_token_ids equal local IDs element by element, and usage.prompt_tokens equals their count when reported
check_definitions.cached_positive: cached_tokens is reported and greater than 0
check_definitions.cached_within_eligible: cached_tokens is at most local prompt length minus one
check_definitions.cached_within_lcp:P: cached_tokens is at most the local exact-ID LCP between this probe and probe P
check_definitions.same_prompt_ids_as:S: returned prompt_token_ids equal those returned at step S
check_definitions.block_prediction:P: cached_tokens equals floor(min(local exact-ID LCP with P, local prompt length - 1) / B) * B, where B is the manifest's recorded block_size_tokens. Assumes P is fully cached and nothing was evicted in between; a mismatch is a recorded failure to explain, not a stop
